text:
miriam: FYI the site build on main is failing with a bunch of unresolved anchors after the Docusaurus migration :grimacing:

miriam: CI snippet:
```
ERROR: unresolved anchor /sdk/js/intro#quickstart -> generated slug `quick-start` not found
WARNING: link /integration/partner#setup -> 404 (anchor not present)
```

jordan: sounds like the mkdocs -> docusaurus slug rules mismatch. mkdocs keeps some punctuation and accents, docusaurus strips/normalizes (NFKD) then collapses separators.

sam: i can run a repo-wide link check. planning: run `node tools/linkcheck --site docs --output failures.json`, then we can triage by owner.

pat: for infra-owned pages i have a small normalizer that mirrors docusaurus behavior. gist:
```js
// normalize to lower, NFKD, strip non-alnum/space/hyphen, collapse spaces
const slug = unicodeNormalize(text).toLowerCase().replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, '-');
```
handles em-dash, smart-quotes, accents.

lee: for partner or external content i'd rather create redirect aliases than edit upstream. we can add `redirect_from: ["/integration/partner#setup"]` in frontmatter on the canonical page. ops will need to reload redirects.

miriam: proposed steps: 1) run linkcheck and generate owner map, 2) auto-fix pages we control with `tools/fix-anchors.js`, 3) add frontmatter redirects for external pages, 4) add a migration note in docs. i'll open a PR with the script + GH action.

miriam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/389 (includes GH Action to run linkcheck on PRs and a small unit test suite).

deply-bot: preview build: https://deploy-preview-389--docs.redwood-inference.com/ — build failed (head: b1c2d3f) :x:

pat: failing because one test expected mkdocs-style slug `installation_guide` while docusaurus yields `installation-guide`. i'll update the test to assert the normalized slug.

jordan: add a test matrix for accent cases and em-dash. also please use NFKD, not NFKC (we want decomposition of composed chars).

sam: i'll add a follow-up GH Action that also runs a lightweight python checker `python -m pip install linkchecker` on the matrix; node's tool misses some edgecases we've hit before.

lee: ops note — when redirects are added, we need to ping CDN/infra to ensure newline-separated redirect file is reloaded; otherwise old anchors keep 404ing.

miriam: thanks. once tests green i'll merge PR 389. tagging @eng-docs and @eng-platform for visibility :pray:

pat: :+1:

jordan: looks good once tests updated.

miriam: merging after green. cheers!
